lede: Ohio State carries the stronger underlying team rating — +11.7 against +2.1, a 9.6-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it Iowa +5.6 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with Ohio State winning 64% of simulations.
The position-group comparison shows where the separation comes from: the widest measured gap is scheme fit, where Ohio State leads Iowa by 126 places nationally.
Data confidence on this matchup is 73% — high by this board’s standards, so the margin is the strongest part of the read.
